scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local PlaceFoodOrder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaceFoodOrder")

local TypedFood = ""
local SelectedFoods = {}

local GamepassFoods = {
    "Seafood Boil",
    "Honey Seafood Boil",
    "Spicy Seafood Boil",
    "2x Spicy",
    "Gooey Brownie",
    "Gooey Velvet",
    "Gooey Dubai",
    "Gooey Vanilla"
}

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Food Order",
    LoadingTitle = "Food Order",
    LoadingSubtitle = "",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    Discord = {
        Enabled = false
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Order", 4483362458)

Tab:CreateInput({
    Name = "Food Order",
    PlaceholderText = "Type any food to give",
    RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
    Callback = function(Text)
        TypedFood = Text
    end
})

Tab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Gamepass Foods",
    Options = GamepassFoods,
    CurrentOption = {},
    MultipleOptions = true,
    Callback = function(Options)
        SelectedFoods = Options
    end
})

Tab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Order Food",
    Callback = function()
        local Foodies = {}

        if TypedFood ~= "" then
            table.insert(Foodies, TypedFood)
        end

        for _, Food in ipairs(SelectedFoods) do
            table.insert(Foodies, Food)
        end

        if #Foodies == 0 then
            Rayfield:Notify({
                Title = "Error",
                Content = "Enter or select at least one food!",
                Duration = 3
            })
            return
        end

        PlaceFoodOrder:FireServer(Foodies)

        Rayfield:Notify({
            Title = "Success",
            Content = "Ordered " .. #Foodies .. " food(s)!",
            Duration = 3
        })
    end
})
